anchors.text: Solid. Meets the bar for the role.
Exceptional. A real interviewer would take note.

items.text: Explained the approach while writing the code.
Names and structure make the code clean and easy to read.
The output is right for the stated task.
Reached a working result in time, or made steady visible progress.
Handled missing values, mixed types and duplicates.
Asked a clarifying question when stuck, rather than going silent.
Summarised the problem in their own words, not by repeating the prompt.
Restated the problem as a clear question about an action and a customer.
Proposed a success metric or KPI.
Signposted the move to the approach with a short transition phrase.
Asked about the current process, competitors and the value at stake.
Asked about the data, class balance and the need for interpretability.
Used the answers in the approach that followed, rather than asking for show.
Kept the questions few, relevant and in scope.
Stated a hypothesis before diving into the solution.
Laid out the approach in a clear, complete order.
Named a model and justified it against the alternatives.
Went into technical detail when challenged.
Made assumptions explicit, with numbers rather than adjectives.
Connected each technical choice back to the business problem.
Handled new information introduced mid-case calmly and usefully.
Gave a crisp recommendation rather than a ramble.
Quantified the expected impact in revenue, cost or percentage.
Covered how it would be delivered, with a timeline and key steps.
Tied the recommendation back to the question from the reframe.
Thought out loud throughout, with no long silences.
Drove the case rather than waiting for the interviewer to lead.
Sounded conversational rather than rehearsed or robotic.
Stayed composed and open when challenged.
Noticed going off track and corrected course unprompted.

bands.label: Early stage
bands.text: Focus on the reframe-structure-synthesis habit and on justifying one model.

bands.label: Needs more practice
bands.text: Find the weakest part and drill it on its own before the next full mock.

bands.label: Solid foundation
bands.text: Good base. Work on the specific parts that scored lowest.

bands.label: Strong
bands.text: Close to ready for a real interview. Keep the habit under time pressure.
